reply_text:
No Zai agent is registered right now. Let me find out how Zai seats get registered.The session ids came out empty because `uuidgen` isn't installed, and all four calls came back as `zai-1`. I'll check what got registered, then redo it properly.Four seats are registered (zai-1…4), and the live site matches the repo. Now I'll write the shared protocol and one persona brief per seat. Each seat gets a different way of arriving at the site.I've sent four simulated customers to the live site. Each is a separate Zai seat, so they can't influence each other. Their reports aren't back yet.

| Seat | Persona | How they visit |
|---|---|---|
| zai-1 | Strategist: MBA, not technical, a family member sent the link | Browses freely, up to 6 pages |
| zai-2 | Engineering manager at a logistics firm, on a phone | Reads only the first ~120 words, then one click at most |
| zai-3 | CTO with a rework and token-bill problem from coding agents | Tries to write a specific enquiry email, up to 8 pages |
| zai-4 | Solo developer, sceptical of consultants | Decides whether to get in touch, copy the ideas, or leave |

**How they're set up:**
- They can only fetch the public site, not the futon repos.
- None of them were told your sister's critique. zai-1 is set up as her stand-in: if it raises her objections without being prompted, that's a sign these runs are realistic.
- Each writes one file with the pages it visited, what it thinks you do / who it's for / what they'd get, its decision (with the email word for word if it would write one), the three phrases that put it off most, and what would have changed its mind.

**One limitation:** they can't see images. Much of `about.html` depends on the demo pictures, so each will report which images it couldn't see instead of guessing.

The briefs and reports go in `storage/futon7a/customer-sims/2026-09-29/`, outside the futon7a repo. When they come back I'll check each one actually produced its file before reading it, then compare them.

**An Agency quirk I ran into:** calling `POST /api/alpha/agents/auto` with an empty `session-id` re-registered `zai-1` every time, instead of creating a new agent on each call as its docstring says. It was my own mistake with the missing `uuidgen` that triggered it; retrying with proper session ids fixed it. It's another failure where the call looks like it worked, so it's worth a ticket.
